Arms three_tier_wc (label hicache from campaign 28), three_tier_to. 18.5 s at x70 (campaign 14); 31.88 s on FA3 with the write fixes (campaign 34). Landed reads unprotected; empty lookups spend the 8-lookup budget.

2. First oracle (v1), reads anchored on admission from exact next-request times (plan 2026-10-01; campaign 15, 2026-10-09). Arms three_tier_wc_oracle, three_tier_to_oracle. 20.8 against 22.2 s; small gain because of one FIFO read thread, memory held by queued reads, unprotected landed reads.

3. Oracle v2 and its levers (plan 2026-10-10; campaigns 16 to 19). Arms three_tier_wc_dl (read pins), three_tier_wc_oracle_v2 (deadline-ordered reads), three_tier_wc_oracle_v2_nu (next-use eviction; label oracle_v2). 13.2, 11.6 and 5.7 s against 18.5 s (campaign 16). Superseded: exact hints only, early reads sit pinned, staged reads not registered with next-use eviction.

4. Gap-table hints, the first realistic hint (2026-10-31; campaigns 20 and 21). Client HINTS=dist on three_tier_wc_oracle_v2_nu ('old p50'), three_tier_wc_oracle_v2_nu_table. p50 20.37 against exact 20.27 s behind a long queue (campaign 20); 1.95 against 1.48 s at 44 users and 70 GB (campaign 21).

5. Just-in-time reads and the 'owned' arm with the arrival gate and the hold (2026-11-01 to 11-05; campaigns 24, 23, 25; fixed-quantile variant fq90 in campaign 26). Arms three_tier_wc_oracle_v2_nu_jit (jit_70), three_tier_wc_oracle_v2_nu_owned (jit_exact, jit_p50, fq90). 0.50 s exact, 1.51 s p50, baseline 5.17 s (campaign 23); on table hints no better than no hints (1.47 s).

6. Hint-free and queue-state arms (2026-11-01 to 11-14; campaigns 21, 25, 26). Arms three_tier_wc_dl_poll0 (hintfree_*), three_tier_wc_poll0, nofc, nofc_noend. Pins alone 79 % of the gain at 44 users; with queued turns kept, gate, hold and re-reads 0.71 and 0.72 s, 96 % of the way to exact hints (campaign 26). Not superseded: the yardstick for any hint.

7. The four rules, 'Pricing the room' (deck 2026-11-06; built 2026-11-11; campaigns 26, 28, 29, 32 to 34). Arms ec_r1, ec_r3, ec_r13, ec_r134, ec_full, ec_exact. ec_full 0.66 s at 44 users (campaign 26), 10.96 s on FA3 (campaign 34); the gain is rule 1's, not shown to beat no hints, and at saturation the rules decide nothing.

8. Two engine defects found on the public traces (2026-11-19 and 11-20). Defect 1, the lookup cap that counts empty lookups: not fixed. Defect 2, the next_use overdue rank of queued turns: fixed 2026-11-22 (commit 94c3dd0c85, engine_queuedfix_20261122; run check jit_exact_qfix, requests it cost a read 57 before and 1 after).

9. FA3 write-path fixes (loop found in campaign 32 on 2026-11-22; verified in campaign 34 on 2026-11-23). Four fixes behind switches plus the host census, engine engine_fa3fix_20261122. Hinted arms 5.8 to 9.5 s faster on the same users, no read refused host room; which fix is needed is not known.
10. Revised design of 23 November: T = G + W and five components (2026-11-23; not built, reviewed on CPU the same day). No arm.

11. Unified four-action design, 'Four actions, three prices' (draft v1 of 2026-11-26; in progress, claims not yet verified, nothing implemented). Campaigns 35 to 37 are set up with ec_full first as the baseline; no result yet.
